prompt: Blue brings home the biggest toy box on the street
title: Toy Box Parade
irony: Blue wheels home the biggest toy box to hold all the fun inside, but it jams the gate and leaves no room to play, so the kids empty it together and she climbs in to play.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Blue drags a tower-tall toy box down the bright street while Green and Navy gape.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green names each toy from the label and begs the street to keep the giant toy box tidy.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: The giant toy box jams tight in the big-house gate and stops the whole street.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street crowd rings the giant toy box and chants what fits inside.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black dares Jade to load the toy box first, and loose toys spill across the street.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Green, Jade and Black pile inside to sort toys and get stuck upside down giggling.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crowd hauls the stuck toy box together and chants the hook even louder.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Blue rests on the big-house step and says she buys big gifts, not playtime.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Blue lays the giant toy box on its side as a tunnel while Green checks each edge.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The street sings as one while Blue climbs inside the empty toy box to play.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The street keeps the empty toy box tunnel open while Blue plays inside with the kids.
